description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage B2B SaaS team as its first infrastructure engineer, owning the runtime, agent infrastructure, observability, and self-hosted deployment experience. You will work closely with the founding team, establish the platform patterns for future hires, and have a path toward leading this domain.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and operate a cloud runtime for integrations, including durable execution, sandboxed isolation, and resilient recovery.

 - Develop infrastructure for coding agents that write, test, and deploy integration code in production.

 - Design observability across logs, metrics, and tracing for integrations and agents.

 - Build and maintain single-tenant, self-hostable product deployments.

 - Own infrastructure and platform decisions end to end, and establish engineering practices for future infrastructure hires.

 - Ship production systems regularly and help grow the team responsible for this area.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Three to nine years of professional software engineering experience, including at least three years in a fast-moving, high-growth startup environment.

 - Production experience operating, scaling, and debugging Kubernetes, with end-to-end ownership of cloud infrastructure or a platform.

 - Hands-on cloud infrastructure experience and a strong understanding of production observability across logs, metrics, and tracing.

 - Experience using AI coding agents effectively while applying sound production engineering judgment.

 - Experience building self-hosted, single-tenant product deployments is valuable.

 - A completed or in-progress engineering, computer science, or quantitative degree and strong technical fundamentals.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $175,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site five days per week in San Francisco, California. Candidates based elsewhere in the United States must have a concrete plan to relocate to San Francisco.
